entries.title: dive map - added zoom level
entries.body: The Dive Map now has closer zoom levels with more detailed coastlines, plus a light map theme for brighter conditions.

entries.title: New image composer presets
entries.body: Create share images with four refined presets: Bottom Profile, Right Information Panel, Bottom Stats Dock, and Solid Info Band. Every seeded layout can be recreated with the composer controls. The signed GitHub APK includes the same presets and updated dive-site catalog.

entries.title: Light theme and Memos shortcut
entries.body: Choose Light or Dark in Settings (saved on this device). Long-press the app icon or use the PWA shortcut to open Dive memos. Android debug APK 1.0.20 includes the same updates.

entries.title: Launched beta test
entries.body: DiveFrame beta testing is open. Import a dive log, try Dive memos, and share feedback. Android debug APK 1.0.19 includes the empty-state dive-profile refresh and related UI polish.

entries.title: Memo match and top bar
entries.body: Dive detail and Dive memos can suggest nearby memos or dives by time. The top bar is shared across pages (Home, About, Settings, Bluetooth/Android app, memos, Import). Dive dates show HH:MM. Android debug APK 1.0.18 includes the same updates.

entries.title: UI copy refresh
entries.body: English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese (HK) strings were refreshed across the app. The About page now leads with Why DiveFrame Exists (with a Read more for the rest), then the companion overview, Open source, and Advanced search. Android debug APK 1.0.17 includes the same updates.

entries.title: Dive memos
entries.body: Jot date, time, location, buddies, and notes before a log exists. Open Dive memos from the import guide. Android debug APK 1.0.16 also fixes What's New / top bar placement under the status bar.

entries.title: Offline site catalog
entries.body: The bundled dive-site catalog works offline. Import a regional supplement in Settings; it is saved on this device and included in backups.
